**About Integrated Bio**
Integrated Bio (integratedbio.com) is a scientific discovery company translating multimodal biological datasets into novel therapeutics, using our drug design platform and AI models. We are risk-takers, and we bet heavily that the future of societal health lies at the intersection of biological discovery, drug design, and AI. Our growing, star-studded team includes accomplished industry veterans and scientists from top universities, including Harvard, Princeton, and UCSB. Our team has deployed large-scale scientific discovery systems, brought drug candidates to the clinic, and published in Nature, Science, and Cell. We have accomplished all of this with no egos, and we are growing fast.
  
  
**About the Role**
We are building a closed-loop discovery engine: AI models that propose hypotheses, high-throughput experiments that test them against living systems, and a feedback cycle that turns experimental results back into better models. Robots are how that loop closes in the physical world.
  
  
This is a software engineering role with a robotics mandate. Most of the work is building systems: data pipelines, services, interfaces, evaluation harnesses, and the control and learning stack that drives our manipulation station. You will also own the hardware side of that station, from mounting and calibration through deployment, and you will write plenty of ordinary application and infrastructure code along the way.
  
  
We are open to a range of experience levels. A strong master's graduate with a portfolio of things they have actually built is as interesting to us as someone senior from a top robotics company. We operate on the timescale of days, not weeks.
  
  
**You will**

* Build the software that makes the robot useful: data infrastructure, services, APIs, and interfaces that our scientists actually run
* Build the teleoperation and data-capture pipeline that turns demonstrations and routine lab work into clean, labeled training data
* Own our robotic manipulation station end to end, including dexterous manipulators, depth cameras, and VR teleoperation, from mounting and calibration through the control stack
* Train, evaluate, and deploy manipulation policies for real laboratory tasks, starting with liquid handling and plate manipulation, and establish success metrics for them
* Stand up simulation for the station so policies can be developed and stress-tested before they touch hardware
* Integrate the robot and the data it produces into our broader AI agent harness
* Automate real experimental workflows alongside the scientists who run them today, and measure what the automation actually saved
* Work across our general engineering stack: tooling for scientists, internal applications, pipelines, and cloud infrastructure

**You're a good fit if you have**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals: architecture, version control, testing, deployment, and systems other people can run
* Experience building full-stack systems, from database and backend infrastructure through to the interfaces people use
* Shipped real robot software: manipulation, motion planning, control, or learned policies, in ROS/ROS2 or an equivalent stack you can defend
* The ability to provision, deploy, and manage cloud resources such as Docker, AWS, and bare metal
* Fluency in leveraging AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and Grok to build software quickly
* Comfort with hardware: mounting, wiring, calibration, and the patient debugging of robots
* A bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree in computer science, robotics, electrical or mechanical engineering, or a related field
* A portfolio of systems you took from nothing to working, ideally with video
* The judgment to decide what to build next when nobody is there to tell you

**Bonus points for**

* Imitation learning in practice: behavior cloning, diffusion policies, ACT, or vision-language-action models
* Teleoperation rigs, VR controllers, or other demonstration-collection systems
* Simulation and sim-to-real transfer (MuJoCo, Isaac Lab, or similar)
* Familiarity with our stack (Postgres, TypeScript, React, modern backend and frontend frameworks)
* Experience building infrastructure and tooling around AI processes and agents (post-training, MCP servers, skills, automations, harnesses)

* Experience with multimodal data, video pipelines, or large-scale data capture
* Curiosity about biology

Join Toyota Automated Logistics and write the software that makes autonomous vehicles move safely through real warehouses. The PLE team owns product variants, sustaining engineering, and select new product development across our growing portfolio — conveyors, AGVs, and emerging product lines — plus the test infrastructure that validates them. This role sits on the vehicle side: motion control, safety systems, and the onboard software that decides how our AGVs behave.
  
  
The PLE Software Developer/Engineer I develops and maintains the onboard software that controls our AGV product lines — from motion and navigation behavior, to the safety systems that protect people working alongside our vehicles, to the interfaces that connect a vehicle to the wider fleet and to fixed automation. This is an entry-level role built for a new graduate: you'll start with well-scoped features, bug fixes, and test development under the mentorship of senior engineers, and grow into ownership of vehicle subsystems as your judgment develops. As PLE’s capacity to support AI robotic vision systems matures, there is a path into perception and vision-guided autonomy work for engineers who want it. Reporting to the Product Line Engineering Systems & Testing Team Lead, you'll partner daily with controls, mechanical, and project engineering.
  
  
**Job Functions**
Vehicle Control Software Development
  
  

* Develop, test, and maintain onboard AGV software — motion control, navigation behavior, vehicle state management, error handling, and diagnostics.
* Implement well-scoped features, enhancements, and defect fixes across AGV product lines and variants, with design review and mentorship from senior engineers.
* Work with onboard controllers and embedded interfaces (CAN, serial, industrial Ethernet) and integrate vehicle software with higher-level PLC and fleet control.
* Contribute to code reviews, version control hygiene, and software documentation as a regular part of the development cycle.

Safety Systems & Compliance
  
  

* Support development and maintenance of AGV safety functions — obstacle detection, protective stop behavior, speed and zone enforcement, and E-stop logic.
* Implement and verify safety-related software under the direction of senior engineers, following applicable functional safety and industrial vehicle standards (ANSI/ITSDF B56.5, ISO 3691-4).
* Maintain traceability between safety requirements, implementation, and verification evidence to support product certification and audit.
* Participate in risk assessments, hazard analyses, and design reviews for vehicle safety behavior.

Testing, Validation & Debug
  
  

* Write and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests for vehicle software; support automated test development where it saves manual effort.
* Validate software on physical AGVs in the engineering lab and test cells — running scenarios, capturing data, and confirming behavior against requirements.
* Troubleshoot vehicle issues using logs, bus analyzers, and data capture tools; perform root cause analysis and drive fixes through to release.
* Support sustaining and field issue resolution across AGV product lines in partnership with project engineering and service.

Engineering Process & Growth Areas
  
  

* Work within the team's Agile cadence — JIRA backlog grooming, sprint commitments, and status transparency.
* Contribute to engineering process and software ownership within PLE, including PLM, design tools, code repositories, and version control practices.
* Grow into AI robotic vision work as the capability develops — perception pipelines, object and obstacle detection, sensor fusion, and vision-guided AGV behavior.
* Take on additional development scope, subsystem ownership, and technical decision-making as skills and product knowledge grow.

**Travel Requirements**

* 5% overnight travel (Travel expenses paid by Toyota Automated Logistics)

**Required Qualifications And Preferred Skills**

* BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Development, or a related technical discipline.
* 0–2 years of professional experience; new and recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Proficiency in at least one of C, C++, C#, or Python, with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and debugging.
* Working knowledge of version control (Git) and collaborative development practices such as branching and code review.
* Willingness to work hands-on with physical hardware in a lab and production environment.
* Strong documentation, communication, and organizational skills.
* Must be eligible to work in the USA long term without sponsorship.
* Employees must follow all information security policies, protect confidential data, complete required training, and report any suspected security incidents to support our information security controls.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/20/2026.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an Engineering and Product Engineer II, you will work side by side with senior functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact GenAI-enabled solutions. This requires a highly motivated practitioner who moves with speed and precision, building working software, engaging confidently with senior stakeholders and engineers to bring measurable business impact from day one. Additional responsibilities include:
  
  
**Client Engagement**

* Embed with clients to identify business needs and translate high-value GenAI use cases into solutions.
* Partner with leaders, product owners, architects, and engineers to align priorities and delivery.
* Lead working sessions to shape solutions and drive client outcomes.
* Prototype and deliver working AI solutions using industry expertise and emerging capabilities.
* Contribute independently within an FDE pod while mentoring newer team members.

**Solution Engineering**

* Build AI-enabled solutions, agentic platforms, and workflows across enterprise AI platforms.
* Develop scalable AI engineering patterns, tool-use approaches, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Apply architecture decisions that balance quality, safety, latency, cost, and model risk.
* Deliver production-quality code using strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation.
* Design extensible functionality, support sprint sizing, and align solutions with senior team members.
* Contribute reusable assets including code, prompt libraries, runbooks, and reference implementations.

**The team**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science or Engineering.
* 1+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, data science, or analytics engineering.
* 1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM-powered solutions in client or production environments
* 1+ years of experience with Palantir including hands-on experience with one of the following key platforms/products; Foundry, AIP, Maven
* 1+ years of experience leading project workstreams/engagements and translating business problems into AI solutions
* 1+ years of experience building reliable, maintainable, and well-documented code

* Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud) and common platform services (storage, compute, IAM, networking)
* Demonstrated ability to work directly alongside client technical teams and program stakeholders in fast-paced, ambiguous delivery environments
* Data engineering experience with Spark, Airflow/dbt, streaming, data modeling or ML/data science background feature engineering, experimentation or model evaluation

**Description**
Prime Video is building the future of TV for customers in over 200 countries to enjoy an endless selection of movies, shows and sports on their TV, mobile devices and desktop. We deliver high-quality video to Amazon customers through subscriptions (Amazon Prime, and Channels) as well as purchases, rentals, and free with ads.
  
  
In Prime Video Personalization and Discovery, our mission is to show a customer the right video content, in the right place, at the right time. We tailor PV for a diverse and global audience, so customers world-wide with different tastes and backgrounds can find something to watch and enjoy on every visit. We delight Prime subscribers by leaning in to the Amazon originals and exclusives that shape our brand and differentiate us. We grow our relationships with customers by leveraging our deep understanding of them to provide relevant and timely recommendations. We believe the current customer experience is only scratching the surface of innovative experiences that are made possible as viewing continues to shift online, and that science is at the center of delivering a step-function change for our CX.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Creating reliable, scalable, and high performance products requires exceptional technical expertise, a sound understanding of the fundamentals of Computer Science, and practical experience building large-scale distributed systems. This person has thrived and succeeded in delivering high quality technology products/services in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift fast.

**Description**
Amazon's eCommerce Foundation (eCF) organization provides the core technologies that drive and power Amazon's Stores, Digital, and Other (SDO) businesses. Millions of customer page views and orders per day are enabled by the systems eCF builds from the ground up. CloudTune, within eCF, empowers growth and business agility needs by automatically and efficiently managing AWS capacity and business processes needed to safely meet Amazon's customer demand. CloudTune serves its primary customers, internal software teams, through forecast-driven automation of cost controllership, capacity management, and scaling. We predict expected load, and drive procurement and allocation of AWS capacity for new product launches and high-velocity events like Prime Day and Cyber Monday.
  
  
CloudTune is looking for a Data Scientist to join our forecasting and optimization team. The team develops sophisticated algorithms that combine machine learning-based demand forecasting with mathematical optimization to solve large-scale capacity planning problems under uncertainty. We work with massive datasets — spanning thousands of availability zone and instance family combinations across global regions — to determine optimal resource allocation strategies that balance infrastructure holding costs against service availability requirements. These models directly inform multi-million dollar capacity investment decisions and drive automated procurement, retention, and release policies across Amazon's compute infrastructure.
  
  
As a Data Scientist in CloudTune, you will work with other scientists, software engineers, data engineers, and product managers on a variety of important research problems in the areas of stochastic optimization, time series modeling, and operations research. You will work on statistical problems with a high level of ambiguity. You will analyze and process large amounts of data, develop new algorithms and improve existing approaches based on statistical models, machine learning algorithms and big data solutions to automatically scale Amazon’s compute infrastructure, optimizing the balance between availability risk and cost efficiency for all of Amazon businesses.

* Process and analyze large data sets, mining additional data sources as needed

**Description**
Do you want to own Identity systems that major AWS and Stores services depends on to exist and the layers that make that data consumable by every service that needs it? The LDAP Core and Switchboard teams are part of the AFSS Identity organization within Amazon's Foundational Security Services. We hold the records of engineering identity at Amazon, and we make that record reachable through modern access pattern.
  
  
LDAP Core operates the canonical engineering identity directory: the 389DS LDAP fleet, its global replication topology, and the regionalized architecture (REGAL) we are building to replace it by 2027. Switchboard builds the routing, temporal, analytical, and control layers that surround that directory the Read Proxy, Time Machine, the Identity Data Lake, and GSAM, the control plane for millions of system accounts across Amazon's engineering data planes.
  
  
Key job responsibilities

* Own 389DS software lifecycle: upgrade train, master fleet replication, schema management across commercial, GovCloud, ADC, China, and MVP
* Drive pipeline-driven automated region builds, eliminating manual ceremony from partition expansion
* Lead schema evolution discipline: document every attribute, analyze consumer impact end-to-end before every change
* Architect and evolve the LDAP Read Proxy: schema-routed access, expansion to BRASS and additional backends, transparent to existing callers
* Own GSAM as the system-account control plane across LDAP, POSIX, ANT : lifecycle management, credential rotation, ANT auto-provisioning, and the path to passwordless system accounts
* Own LDAP Time Machine and the Identity Data Lake: snapshot pipelines, S3 vending, cross-region log analytics, and IdP security intelligence
* Set the observability standard across every access path -direct, proxied, historical, analytical, consistent telemetry, uniform authorization
* Serve as Tier-1 on-call anchor for directory availability and replication health
* Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across both teams

As an Engineering and Product Engineer II, you will work side by side with senior functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact GenAI-enabled solutions. * Partner with leaders, product owners, architects, and engineers to align priorities and delivery.

* Design extensible functionality, support sprint sizing, and align solutions with senior team members.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science or Engineering.
* 1+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, data science, or analytics engineering.
* 1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM-powered solutions in client or production environments
* 1+ years of experience with Palantir including hands-on experience with one of the following key platforms/products; Foundry, AIP, Maven
* 1+ years of experience leading project workstreams/engagements and translating business problems into AI solutions
* 1+ years of experience building reliable, maintainable, and well-documented code
* Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud) and common platform services (storage, compute, IAM, networking)
* Demonstrated ability to work directly alongside client technical teams and program stakeholders in fast-paced, ambiguous delivery environments
* Data engineering experience with Spark, Airflow/dbt, streaming, data modeling or ML/data science background feature engineering, experimentation or model evaluation
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps practices: evaluation frameworks, model monitoring, and prompt management
* Experience integrating LLM solutions with enterprise systems via APIs, microservices, or event-driven architectures
* Experience operating within hybrid onshore/offshore teams
* Familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerations

**Main Purpose of Job**
The Maryland Office of Inspector General for Health is an independent state agency responsible for identifying Fraud, Waste, and Abuse of Maryland Department of Health (MDH) funds and investigating behavior in the Department that threatens public safety or demonstrates negligence, incompetence, or abuse. This position shall maintain confidentiality and impartiality when conducting their duties.
  
  
The Data Scientist works closely with the data analysts, auditors, investigators and clinicians in the day-to-day operations of the Office of the Inspector General (OIGH) and on special projects as necessary. The Data Scientist analyzes large datasets to improve government services, formulate policy, and drive efficiency. This role requires a blend of quantitative expertise and data science skills and ability to apply these skills to various data sets and regulations. This position assists the OIGH’s mission to protect the integrity of the MDH and promote standards that benefit the citizens of Maryland and beneficiaries of its programs.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
**Education**
: Graduation from an accredited high school or possession of a high school equivalency certificate.
  
  
**Experience**
: Six years of administrative staff or professional work.
  
  
**Notes**

* Candidates may substitute 30 credit hours from an accredited college or university for each year up to four years of the required experience.
* Candidates may substitute the possession of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university and two years of experience in administrative staff or professional work for the required experience.
* Candidates may substitute the possession of a Master's degree from an accredited college or university for five years of the required experience.
* Candidates may substitute U.S. Armed Forces military service experience as a commissioned officer involving staff work related to the administration of rules, regulations, policy, procedures and processes, or overseeing or coordinating unit operations or functioning as a staff assistant to a higher ranking commissioned officer on a year-for-year basis for the required experience.

**Desired Or Preferred Qualifications**
The desired candidate should possess the following:
  
  

* Experience working with Python, SQL, Power BI, or Tableau.
* Experience analyzing large and complex healthcare datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and inconsistencies.
* Experience comparing data against established rules, regulations, policies, and criteria to detect deviations, potential noncompliance, and indicators of risk.

At Deloitte, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) don't just build AI solutions, they help clients turn AI ambition into enterprise-scale impact, pairing leading class engineering with pod-based delivery and vertical expertise. If you thrive at the intersection of product, engineering, problem-solving, and client impact, this role puts you at the forefront of AI transformations.
  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 11/20/2026.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an Engineering and Product Engineer II, you will work side by side with senior functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact GenAI-enabled solutions. This requires a highly motivated practitioner who moves with speed and precision, building working software, engaging confidently with senior stakeholders and engineers to bring measurable business impact from day one. Additional responsibilities include:
  
  
**Client Engagement**

* Embed with clients to identify business needs and translate high-value GenAI use cases into solutions.
* Partner with leaders, product owners, architects, and engineers to align priorities and delivery.
* Lead working sessions to shape solutions and drive client outcomes.
* Prototype and deliver working AI solutions using industry expertise and emerging capabilities.
* Contribute independently within an FDE pod while mentoring newer team members.

**Solution Engineering**

* Build AI-enabled solutions, agentic platforms, and workflows across enterprise AI platforms.
* Develop scalable AI engineering patterns, tool-use approaches, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Apply architecture decisions that balance quality, safety, latency, cost, and model risk.
* Deliver production-quality code using strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation.
* Design extensible functionality, support sprint sizing, and align solutions with senior team members.
* Contribute reusable assets including code, prompt libraries, runbooks, and reference implementations.

**The team**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science or Engineering.
* 1+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, data science, or analytics engineering.
* 1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM-powered solutions in client or production environments
* 1+ years of experience with Palantir including hands-on experience with one of the following key platforms/products; Foundry, AIP, Maven
* 1+ years of experience leading project workstreams/engagements and translating business problems into AI solutions
* 1+ years of experience building reliable, maintainable, and well-documented code
* Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud) and common platform services (storage, compute, IAM, networking)
* Demonstrated ability to work directly alongside client technical teams and program stakeholders in fast-paced, ambiguous delivery environments
* Data engineering experience with Spark, Airflow/dbt, streaming, data modeling or ML/data science background feature engineering, experimentation or model evaluation
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps practices: evaluation frameworks, model monitoring, and prompt management
* Experience integrating LLM solutions with enterprise systems via APIs, microservices, or event-driven architectures
* Experience operating within hybrid onshore/offshore teams
* Familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerations

**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is building a central pipeline of Software Development Engineer (SDE) talent for anticipated roles in 2026. This requisition supports hiring across all AWS SDE positions, from fungible SDE roles to specialized engineering positions in areas including:
  
  

* Embedded Systems
* Game Development
* Compiler Engineering
* Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning
* Healthcare AI
* Infrastructure Services
* Firmware Development
* Cloud Computing
* Distributed Systems
* Security Engineering
* Video Processing and Streaming
* Content Delivery Network (CDN)

When you apply to this position, your profile will be considered for current and future SDE openings across AWS, including teams such as Twitch, AWS Elemental, and AWS CloudFront.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**As An AWS Software Development Engineer, You Will**

* Design, develop, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code
* Implement complex software solutions that meet business requirements
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
* Participate in architecture and design reviews to provide technical guidance
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for process enhancement
* Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a strong engineering culture

A day in the life
  
  
On a typical day as an AWS SDE, you might:
  
  

* Start your morning with a team stand-up to align on priorities and address any blockers
* Collaborate with product managers to refine requirements for upcoming features
* Write code and develop solutions for complex technical challenges
* Review pull requests from team members, providing constructive feedback

* Build AI-enabled solutions, agentic platforms, and workflows across enterprise AI platforms.
* Develop scalable AI engineering patterns, tool-use approaches, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Apply architecture decisions that balance quality, safety, latency, cost, and model risk.
* Deliver production-quality code using strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation.
* Design extensible functionality, support sprint sizing, and align solutions with senior team members.
* Contribute reusable assets including code, prompt libraries, runbooks, and reference implementations.

**The team**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science or Engineering.
* 1+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, data science, or analytics engineering.
* 1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM-powered solutions in client or production environments
* 1+ years of experience with Palantir including hands-on experience with one of the following key platforms/products; Foundry, AIP, Maven
* 1+ years of experience leading project workstreams/engagements and translating business problems into AI solutions
* 1+ years of experience building reliable, maintainable, and well-documented code
* Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud) and common platform services (storage, compute, IAM, networking)
* Demonstrated ability to work directly alongside client technical teams and program stakeholders in fast-paced, ambiguous delivery environments
* Data engineering experience with Spark, Airflow/dbt, streaming, data modeling or ML/data science background feature engineering, experimentation or model evaluation
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps practices: evaluation frameworks, model monitoring, and prompt management
* Experience integrating LLM solutions with enterprise systems via APIs, microservices, or event-driven architectures
* Experience operating within hybrid onshore/offshore teams

**Description**
The AmSec Endpoint Security Capabilities and Prevention Engineering team build and operate first and third party services for the monitoring and response to malicious activity on the Amazon internal devices. We collect data from all parts of Amazon's environment worldwide.
  
  
We seek a Software Development Engineer who is excited about solving challenging problems by developing our own solutions that protect Amazon and our customer data. Our challenges are broad and deep -- we build flexible, secure, scalable, high-performance and robust tools and services. These services enable our security engineers and analysts to detect and respond to malicious activity on our infrastructure. In Amazon Security we operate multiple large scale data query platforms to allow security engineers to detect anomalies and facilitate threat hunting. You will work with a group of engineers to operate these services to the highest operational level while building new tools and services to improve the customer experience and make it easier/faster/cheaper for the customer to get what they need.
  
  
In AmSec, we obsess over our customers, and their trust is our first priority. Trust is earned by building a highly respected security team to tackle new challenges at a large scale. In this role, you will deliver high quality, scalable products that are deployed to our internal services around the world. You will collaborate with product owners and customers to deliver the best features, using resources and technologies efficiently. You will work with stakeholders to define solutions that scale and satisfy a wide variety of security needs. You will also assess risks, anticipate bottlenecks, and balance business needs against technical constraints to maximize business benefit.
  
  
On-Call Responsibility
  
  
This position involves on-call responsibilities. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, implement and maintain platform services and features using AWS to build highly scalable solutions.
* Automate deployments, upgrades and system changes to ensure continous operations
* Partner with cross-functional teams to understand their use cases and build solutions to automate their workflows.
* Enable customers to automate security tasks and track success metrics using our tooling
* Participate in on-call operations to ensure system reliability and continuity across the company
* Identify opportunities to enhance skills in software development, cloud computing and security

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why Amazon Security?
  
  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

**Description**
Training and running large AI models takes enormous amounts of expensive accelerated compute, and most of it sits idle. Across the industry, a large share of GPU capacity is paid for but never does useful work because jobs cannot find it, cannot share it, or cannot see it and use it efficiently. We build the services that closes that gap.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build the systems that put idle or inefficiently used GPUs to work. You will design and build distributed backend services that let organizations pool capacity across many clusters and accounts, route it to the workloads that need it most, and see exactly how it is being used. This is deep systems work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, container orchestration, and cloud infrastructure, and it directly changes how much value customers get from every GPU they pay for.
  
  
You will own services end to end, from design through launch and operation in production, and your work will ship to some of the largest AI compute customers in the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design, build, and operate distributed backend services that manage and share accelerated compute across multiple clusters and accounts.
  
  
Build scheduling and capacity-sharing capabilities that move compute to the highest-priority workloads and reclaim it when priorities change.
  
  
Build zero-touch usage and guidance systems that collect, aggregate, and report how compute is consumed, at scale and in near real time.
  
  
Own your services in production: define operational metrics, respond to issues, and continuously improve reliability, latency, and cost.
  
  
Write clear design documents, participate in design and code reviews, and raise the engineering bar for the team.
  
  
Collaborate with product, design, and partner engineering teams to turn customer problems into shipped features.
  
  
Mentor other engineers and contribute to a culture of ownership, quality, and customer focus.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Most days start with a short team stand-up, then it is mostly building. You might design a service that lets one cluster borrow idle capacity from another, then write it up for a design review where the team pokes holes in it before any code is written. Hard problems get their own deep-dive whiteboard session. Other days lean toward operations, chasing down why a workload did not get the capacity it should have. You will not be handed fully specified tasks; you will have the independence to help decide what to build, then build it.
  
  
**About The Team**
We help customers get the most out of the accelerated compute they pay for. Our mission is simple to say and hard to do: make sure every accelerator a customer pays for is doing useful work, and make that easy to see and control. Cost reduction is one important part of that, but the bigger idea is the engine that delivers compute to the workloads that need it most, in as little time as possible.
  
  
Our customers run some of the largest AI training and inference workloads in the world, and they feel the impact of our work directly in how much they can do with their infrastructure. We care about depth, we own our work end to end, and we build in the open where we can.

Salesforce Developer with python
  
  
Must Have Technical/Functional Skills
  
  

* Technical Profile Summary

The Senior Salesforce Developer will design, develop, and optimize scalable enterprise architectures across core Salesforce clouds and decoupled middleware/data ecosystems. This role bridges programmatic Salesforce engineering (Apex, LWC) with modern programmatic backend capabilities (Python), leading API-first integrations, data pipeline engineering, automation frameworks, and maintainable enterprise software design patterns.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  

* Core Salesforce Platform & Programmatic Development (Mandatory)
* Apex Engineering & Architecture:
* Advanced object-oriented programming (OOP) using enterprise design patterns (Trigger Handler frameworks, Service Layer pattern, Domain/Selector layer, Unit of Work pattern).
* Asynchronous processing mastery: Batch Apex, Queueable Apex with chaining, Schedulable jobs, and Continuation patterns for long-running callouts.
* Rigorous transaction management and governor limit mitigation strategies (SOQL/SOSL query optimization, heap size tuning, and bulkified CPU execution profiling).
* Comprehensive automated testing using Apex Mocks, stub APIs, and enterprise-grade test isolation fixtures achieving resilient code coverage.
* Modern Frontend (Lightning Web Components & UX):
* Modern JavaScript (ES6+) and Lightning Web Components (LWC) reactive programming, lifecycle hooks, wire adapters, and @api/@track state architecture.
* Component orchestration via Lightning Message Service (LMS), custom events, and publish-subscribe paradigms across decoupled UI boundaries.
* Experience handling complex data tables, real-time client validation, custom modal interactions, and Lightning Design System (SLDS) styling standards.
* Legacy maintenance and refactoring capabilities: aura component modernization and Visualforce deprecation roadmaps.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  

* Enterprise Integration & Middleware Architecture (Mandatory)
* API Development & Protocols:
* Designing and consuming custom RESTful and SOAP web services (Apex REST APIs, external REST endpoints, JSON/XML parsing).
* Deep understanding of Salesforce native integration APIs: Composite API, Bulk API 2.0, Streaming API, and GraphQL API.
* Event-Driven Architectures (EDA) using Platform Events, Change Data Capture (CDC), and Pub/Sub APIs for real-time decoupled event streaming.
* Security & Authentication:
* OAuth 2.0 flows (JWT Bearer Token flow, Web Server flow, Authorization Code, Client Credentials) and mutual TLS (mTLS).
* Named Credentials, External Credentials, Connected Apps configuration, and certificate-based mutual authentication.
* Hybrid Middleware & Microservices:
* Integrating Salesforce with enterprise middleware (e.g., MuleSoft, Apache Kafka, AWS EventBridge, Azure Service Bus).
* Idempotency handling, exponential backoff, error retry queues, and dead-letter queue (DLQ) architectures.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  

* Python Development & Data Ecosystem (Mandatory)
* Python Capabilities & Tooling:
* Advanced proficiency in Python 3.x (functional programming, object-oriented design, type hinting, concurrency with asyncio, multithreading, or multiprocessing).
* Direct experience with Salesforce programmatic interaction libraries such as simple-salesforce, beatbox, and official REST/Bulk API wrappers.
* Microservice / API development using frameworks like FastAPI, Flask, or AWS Lambda serverless functions.
* Data Engineering & Automation Pipelines:
* Designing Python-driven ETL/ELT pipelines for high-volume data synchronization between Salesforce and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, AWS Redshift, or Databricks).
* Data manipulation and cleansing using libraries such as pandas, polars, and numpy for data sanitation, mass deduplication, and complex transformations.
* Automated operational scripts for bulk data extract, compliance validation, and platform telemetry aggregation.

As a remote-first organization headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie values meaningful in-person connection and collaboration that strengthens our teams, supports our clients, and enhances our culture. While travel requirements vary by role, periodic travel may be required to support business objectives, team collaboration, customer engagements, training, and company events. Candidates should be able and willing to travel as needed to fulfill the responsibilities of the role.
  
  
**About The Team And What We’ll Build Together**
Kobie runs some of the largest loyalty programs in the world. We're building an internal agent platform on Amazon AgentCore that automates analyst workflows, surfaces insights from program data in Snowflake, and gives our teams and clients an LLM-native way to work with complex loyalty logic.
  
  
We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to ship on that platform: building agent harnesses, writing the tools those agents call, and owning the reliability and evaluation of what goes to production. This is not a research role. You'll prototype, ship, monitor, and iterate on features used by real teams
  
  
Our team tends to be people who reason carefully, ship working code,and pick up new tools without a lot of handholding. There’s no single path into this role. We value the impact of what you’ve built and your track record of building things that hold up.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**
**Agent Development**

* Build agent harnesses in Python using LangChain and LangGraph, including tool-calling, structured outputs (Pydantic/JSON schema), retries, streaming, and memory
* Package agent harnesses for the AgentCore Runtime with appropriate context, tools, skills, and subagents that fit cleanly into production flows and scenarios
* Write the tools and skills agents use API integrations, SQL queries against Snowflake, Snowflake backed knowledge retrieval with clear contracts and Pydantic validation

**Evaluation and Reliability**

* Build evaluation harnesses (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression suites) using AgentCore Evaluations, and wire them into CI
* Implement guardrails around tool execution: auth scoping, input/output validation, PII and prompt-injection protections, and hallucination mitigation
* You own what you ship: prototype, deploy through Amazon AgentCore, monitor traces, and fix it when it breaks

**Collaboration**

* Partner with data engineers on Snowflake backed retrieval patterns (Cortex Analyst and Cortex Search Services)
* Contribute to refining our internal engineering patterns as the stack evolves

**Required**
**What you need to be successful**

* 3+ years of professional Python, with production experience building and operating services
* 1+ years of hands-on work with LLMs in production: prompt/context engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, RAG
* Working knowledge of LangChain/LangGraph or a comparable framework like AgentCore Strands, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel
* Experience with LLM observability tools: Amazon CloudWatch, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, or OpenTelemetry
* Experience designing evaluation frameworks (MLFlow, DeepEval, LLM-as-judge, multi-turn regression)
* Fluency with Git, Docker, and modern API frameworks
* Clear written communication and the judgment to know when something is ready to ship

**A bachelor's degree is not required.**
Equivalent practical experience: including bootcamps, self-taught work, career changes, or non-CS technical degrees counts.
  
  
**Strongly Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock and/or AgentCore as a developer: runtime, gateways, memory, policy, guardrails, observability, awscli, evaluations
* Experience with Snowflake, Snowpark, or Snowflake Cortex
* Fluency in writing and reading SQL, as well as understanding semantic models
* Familiarity with multi-agent patterns: supervisor/router, subagent/handoff, reflection, human-in-the-loop
* A considered view on where agents should and shouldn't act and comfort pushing back when "let's add an agent" isn't the right answer
* Experience in Loyalty, MarTech, AdTech, or a comparable data rich B2B domain

**About Millennium**
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.
  
  
Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.
  
  
**Meet the Team**
Information Technology is core to the health and growth of our business; the firm’s active, multi-manager business model demands flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems, including the development of the next generation of analytical and trading capabilities. Within the Digital Assets technology group, the platform team manages the full lifecycle of trading, data and analytics, reconciliation, and reporting platforms. The team analyzes structured and unstructured digital asset data across public and private markets, along with large fundamental blockchain and alternative data sets. Operating across on-prem and cloud-based environments and leveraging cloud-native services as required, the team works closely with other core engineering teams to incorporate data pipelines, data products, and research into the firm’s overall reference, market, and alternative data environment.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Partner with the COO of Digital Assets, the Head of Technology, and Digital Assets Engineering Leads to evaluate data providers and implement the strategic roadmap for digital asset data.
* Analyze real-time and historical digital asset data sources and integrate them into firm platforms.
* Build solutions that transform unstructured data into a form suitable for analysis and platform ingestion, with a strong emphasis on data quality and resiliency.
* Ongoing design and development of order management, trading, reconciliation and risk platform.
* Support business decisions with ad hoc analysis as needed.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years of hands-on Python experience writing reusable, efficient code for analytics and data processes. Ideally building scalable, reliable data pipelines with platforms such as Snowflake and Airflow.
* 2+ years of experience deploying and managing AWS environments for data pipelines and intelligence services.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Experience processing large structured and unstructured datasets with strong quality and resiliency controls, and managing connectivity to data vendors in this space for 24/7 systems.
* Broad understanding of financial instruments required, with equities, fixed income, or commodities exposure a plus, and a passion for digital assets/cryptocurrency backed by a strong understanding of primary markets and key sources of blockchain data.
* Demonstrated passion for AI/ML with hands-on integration across the SDLC (feature engineering, model development/deployment, evaluation/monitoring) to enhance data quality, analytics, and automation.
* Positive, self-driven, hands-on engineer who is effective under pressure and makes sound design and architecture decisions.

**Salary Range**
Millennium offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual’s experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.
